description: The collection and the condition of a for expression may be variables named in and if
notes: The spec says that where an identifier works as a keyword, its keyword role supersedes any other interpretation, and a for expression is a place where for, in and if work as keywords, so a variable named in right after the in keyword, or one named if right after the if keyword, could be invalid. hashicorp/hcl accepts it: finishParsingForExpr in hclsyntax/parser.go parses the collection and the condition with ParseExpression, and parseExpressionTerm reads any identifier other than true, false and null as a variable.
